children.name: Davallia
children.description: Davallia — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Davallia affinis
children.description: The native range of this species is S. India, Sri Lanka, SE. Thailand to Malesia. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Davallia angustata
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Indo-China to Palau (Babeldoab). It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Davallia assamica
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Himalaya to China (Yunnan) and N. Myanmar. It is a epiphyte or lithophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Davallia beddomei

children.name: Davallia bullata
children.description: Davallia bullata, the squirrel's-foot fern, is a fern in the family Davalliaceae found mainly in Japan and China.

children.name: Davallia canariensis
children.description: Davallia canariensis, the hare's-foot fern, is a species of fern in the family Davalliaceae.
